'''Pokémon Journeys''' (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスター ～サトシとゴウの物語！～''' ''Pocket Monsters ~{{tt|Satoshi|Ash}} and {{tt|Go|Goh}}'s Story!~'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} series by [[Machito Gomi]]. It is an adaptation of ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'' from ''[[JN002|Legend? Go! Friends? Go!]]'' to ''[[JN080|Trial on a Golden Scale!]]'' and was serialized in the ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Comics]]'' magazine.

On September 17, 2021, the series' mangaka announced the manga would end in issue 24, ending in four volumes.<ref>[https://twitter.com/dorisuto01/status/1438811515516116996 Machito Gomi on Twitter] (Japanese)</ref>

==Trivia==
* Not including {{pkmn|movie}} adaptations, this is the first manga adaptation of {{aniseries|PTS}} since {{OBP|Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl|Sakai Takayuki}}, which ended ten years prior.
* This manga shares its Japanese name with [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]]. It also replaced the {{OBP|Pocket Monsters Sun Moon|Kosaku Anakubo|Sun and Moon arc}} of Pokémon Pocket Monsters, ending its run in the ''CoroCoro Comics'' magazine after 23 years.
** Since then, the Anakubo mangas are running on ''CoroCoro Online''. They were also serialised in ''CoroCoro Aniki'', until the publication ended in early 2021.
